title: Destroy may not be called from edit mode! Use DestroyImmediate instead.
notes: Fix 2026-10-24 by claude (f8af9fb5b): Unity Multiplayer Tools' RuntimeUpdater called Destroy at ExitingPlayMode in 2.2.6; 2.2.12 (bleeding-edge since 2026-10-09) calls DestroyImmediate. Every sighting carries an older package hash. Pull bleeding-edge.
